summary: At first @vconnecting #lra18 session I noted we need to stop talking about Open and just do it. Each year at LRA I spin up a open source tool community could use. This year it's journal where we can publish all our work from our own blogs: https://samizdat.jgregorymcverry.com

body_html: At first @vconnecting #lra18 session I noted we need to stop talking about Open and just do it. Each year at LRA I spin up a open source tool community could use. This year it's journal where we can publish all our work from our own blogs: https://samizdat.jgregorymcverry.com
